hooks.command: ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && cd "$ROOT" && nohup .venv/bin/python "🔧 Automation/scripts/hooks/session_end.py" --workspace "$ROOT" --python-cmd ".venv/bin/python" </dev/null >>"$ROOT/.cache/claude/hooks/session-end.log" 2>&1 &
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && PYTHONPATH="🔧 Automation/scripts" .venv/bin/python "🔧 Automation/scripts/hooks/compact_state.py" capture
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && PYTHONPATH="🔧 Automation/scripts" .venv/bin/python "🔧 Automation/scripts/hooks/end_of_turn.py"
